ocr.notes: One garbled phrase: 'will use light gloves' read as 'will use Ma cee'.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported from New York that Tom Allen of St. Louis and Jack Stewart of Glasgow were matched to fight with light gloves for £200 a side at Glasgow in the first week of March.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Thursday Morning, February 13, 1879, page 2. Dispatch dated New York, February 12.

facts.fact: Allen was matched to fight Jack Stewart of Glasgow under the new rules of the London prize ring, with light gloves, for £200 a side, the fight to take place at Glasgow the first week in March 1879

notes: The fight actually took place in London on April 22, 1879 (see 625).
